```artifact
Feature: Virtual Healthcare Services within Padmavathi Hospital Zone

  Scenario: Patient can register and apply for appointments within the specified radius
    Given the patient resides within a 25 sqkm radius of Padmavathi Hospital
    When the patient attempts to register and apply for an appointment
    Then the system should allow the patient to register and apply for the appointment

  Scenario Outline: Patient can only register and apply for appointments within specified PinCodes
    Given the patient resides in a PinCode <PinCode>
    When the patient attempts to register and apply for an appointment
    Then the system should <allow/deny> the patient to register and apply for the appointment

    Examples:
      | PinCode | allow/deny |
      | 517501  | allow      |
      | 517502  | allow      |
      | 517503  | deny       |

  Scenario: There is 1 Authorized Chemist per PinCode
    Given the patient resides in a PinCode <PinCode>
    When the system routes a prescription request
    Then the system should route the prescription to the authorized chemist in PinCode <PinCode>

    Examples:
      | PinCode |
      | 517501  |
      | 517502  |

  Scenario: Prescription requests are routed based on matching PinCodes
    Given the patient's address PinCode is <PatientPinCode>
    And the authorized chemist's PinCode is <ChemistPinCode>
    When the system routes a prescription request
    Then the system should route the prescription to the chemist in PinCode <ChemistPinCode>

    Examples:
      | PatientPinCode | ChemistPinCode |
      | 517501         | 517501         |
      | 517502         | 517502         |

  Scenario: Chemist delivers medicines through Offline delivery and collects payments
    Given the chemist has received a prescription request
    When the chemist delivers the medicines
    Then the chemist should collect payment from the patient

  Scenario: Chemist marks the prescription on completion of delivery
    Given the chemist has delivered the medicines
    When the chemist completes the delivery
    Then the system should mark the prescription as delivered

  Scenario: No systemic matching is done to figure out efficiency of the Chemist
    Given the system has routed a prescription request to a chemist
    When the chemist completes the delivery
    Then the system should not perform any efficiency matching on the chemist

  Scenario: There is 1 Authorized Laboratory per PinCode or 1 Laboratory for the entire Zone
    Given the patient resides in a PinCode <PinCode>
    When the system routes a test request
    Then the system should route the test request to the authorized laboratory in PinCode <PinCode> or the Zone laboratory

    Examples:
      | PinCode |
      | 517501  |
      | 517502  |
```
